==Special chapters==
These chapters were published in [[Pokémon the Comic]] as the result of {{adv|Red}} and [[Pika]] respectively winning the human and Pokémon sections on the 2011 Netkun popularity poll. Neither were collected into the volume format as part of any of the story arcs or officially translated into English.
